plates.title: Front plate
plates.how: One big window and no grooves on the side edges. The only plate whose sides are perfectly straight.

plates.title: L1 - glass pocket
plates.how: A large opening, almost the full width of the plate. This is the pocket the display glass drops into. Side grooves present.

plates.title: L2 - wire recess
plates.how: The only 3 mm plate. Smaller opening, and inside each side groove there is a small extra notch. If you can only find one thick plate, this is it.

plates.title: L3
plates.how: Smaller opening, plain side grooves, no notch. L3, L4 and L5 are the same part - their order does not matter.

plates.title: L5
plates.how: Identical to L3 and L4. Sits at the very back; the washers and nuts land on it.
